rationale: The tenant has had no working oven for weeks. The contractor has given no substantive update since 23 May (022) despite calls on 5, 6 and 8 June (033-038) and a promise to check with the supplier (035). Chasing the contractor firmly for the supplier's warranty answer is the next step; after this much silence, handing it to the property manager is also reasonable. The agency called again (039) and the same day learned the oven is under a 2-year manufacturer's warranty (042). Booking another, chargeable contractor without the landlord's approval would undercut the warranty route the landlord asked for (006).
